title: 级数匹配的 RKDG 一维线性对流收敛率复测（SSP-RK(5,4) 补齐 p=4 档）
domain: TensorDG / 高阶 DG 精度验证

external_anchor.author: Zheng Sun
external_anchor.title: Reducing polynomial degree by one for inner-stage operators affects neither stability type nor accuracy order of the Runge-Kutta discontinuous Galerkin method
external_anchor.experiment: 1-D linear advection u_t + u_x = 0 on the periodic unit interval, u(x,0)=sin(2 pi x), uniform meshes, t^n = 1

method.statement: DG(p) 配 (p+1) 级显式 RK，逐阶对齐 ref 表列级数；p=4 用 SSP-RK(5,4)（5 级 4 阶）

why_not_alternatives.reason: stage count does not match the reference column; at p=4 the time integrator caps the observed order

why_not_alternatives.option: 6-stage order-5 Butcher RK at p=4 (round 2 default)
why_not_alternatives.reason: order matched but the stage count did not; the reference column has 5 stages

why_not_alternatives.option: claim order = stages = p+1 at p=4
why_not_alternatives.reason: impossible: explicit 5-stage methods cannot reach order 5 (Butcher barrier)

method.tableau_reference: Spiteri & Ruuth, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 40 (2002) 469-491 eq.(3.5); Ketcheson, SISC 30 (2008) 2113-2135
method.estimator: log E - log N 最小二乘斜率（ref/got 同一估计器，舍入 1e-12 双侧剔除）

migration: tensordg/runge_kutta.py: add SSP_RK54 (derived from the Shu-Osher form) + MAX_ORDER_FOR_STAGES; tableau_for_degree selects by stage count
benchmarks/case_dg_advect_order_matched_rk.py: stage-matching M2 criterion + fixed-sign time-order probe (M5) instead of not_run
tests: tableau order conditions, stage-matched selection, probe sign
